issues.title: Add localization foundation for UI strings and language switching
issues.body:
## Summary
Phuzzle already has enough depth that localization is worth doing right. Add an i18n foundation so UI copy can be translated without touching gameplay logic.

## Why this matters
- Opens the door for more players and contributors.
- Makes future feature work easier to ship in multiple languages.
- Helps remove hard-coded UI text from components.

## Scope
- Introduce a translation layer for app UI copy.
- Add a language preference in settings.
- Persist the selected language locally.
- Default to English if a key is missing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Core navigation and home/play/stats UI copy is sourced through a translation system.
- Players can change language in-app without refreshing.
- The app falls back safely to English for missing strings.
- Existing tests continue to pass, with at least one localization-focused test added.

## Notes
Start with a narrow, stable surface area rather than trying to translate every string in one pass.

issues.title: Ship first non-English language pack for UI copy
issues.body:
## Summary
Once localization infrastructure exists, add the first translated language so the feature is real and testable.

## Suggested target
Spanish is a strong first candidate because it has broad reach and is practical for early validation.

## Scope
- Translate the highest-traffic UI strings.
- Verify modal layouts and button sizes with longer translated copy.
- Catch any hard-coded English strings still leaking into the UI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- One complete non-English language is available from settings.
- Home, puzzle selection, play HUD, completion, and stats have translated copy.
- Mobile layout still fits translated strings without clipping.
- Missing translation keys are identified and cleaned up.

## Notes
This should be treated as a polish + correctness pass, not just a string dump.

issues.title: Add import-from-image URL flow for custom puzzles
issues.body:
## Summary
The roadmap already calls out puzzle import from URL. Bring that back as a polished flow so players can create puzzles from images they find online.

## Why this matters
- Huge replay value.
- Lets players bring their own content into the app.
- Creates strong shareability and creator energy.

## Scope
- Add a guided URL import flow with validation.
- Show a preview before starting the puzzle.
- Handle invalid URLs and failed image loads gracefully.
- Keep the existing staged modal flow feeling intentional.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A player can paste an image URL and start a puzzle from it.
- Broken URLs and unsupported images show helpful errors.
- The imported puzzle works with existing play modes and completion flows.
- The flow feels mobile-friendly and does not require a desktop-only interaction.

issues.title: Strengthen offline-first behavior for puzzle images and active saves
issues.body:
## Summary
Phuzzle already has good resume behavior, but the app would feel far stronger if puzzle assets and active sessions held up better offline.

## Why this matters
- Makes the app feel premium and dependable.
- Helps mobile users who lose connection mid-session.
- Supports PWA expectations better.

## Scope
- Cache recently played puzzle assets more aggressively.
- Preserve active puzzle state across flaky connectivity.
- Make offline availability visible in a calm, user-friendly way.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Recently played puzzles can reopen offline.
- Active local progress remains recoverable after a connectivity drop.
- The app shows a clear but lightweight offline state when needed.
- No regression to normal online startup performance.

issues.title: Create weekly event puzzles with rotating modifiers and rewards
issues.body:
## Summary
Daily gives good momentum, but a weekly event layer could add a stronger reason to return and compete.

## Example concept
A weekly featured puzzle or pack with a rotating modifier such as fog, night, precision, or speedrun scoring.

## Scope
- Add one weekly event surface on the home screen.
- Rotate a modifier and featured puzzle automatically.
- Track completion and best performance for the event window.
- Reuse existing stats and leaderboard patterns where possible.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A weekly event is visible and easy to start from home.
- The event has a distinct ruleset or modifier from normal play.
- Players can see whether they already completed it.
- Event results feel connected to the rest of the game rather than bolted on.

issues.title: Add unlockable cosmetic rewards tied to streaks and milestones
issues.body:
## Summary
Phuzzle has good stats and streak mechanics, but it needs more delightful long-term rewards players can show off.

## Reward ideas
- Theme variants
- Tray skins
- Piece glow styles
- Badge frames
- Seasonal cosmetic unlocks

## Scope
- Define a first small reward set.
- Hook unlocks into existing stats, streak, or achievement events.
- Add a lightweight place for players to see what they have earned.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Players can unlock at least one visible cosmetic reward through normal play.
- Reward unlocks are persisted and shown in the UI.
- The reward system feels celebratory but not noisy.
- Locked versus unlocked states are easy to understand.

issues.title: Add a puzzle-of-the-week community voting flow
issues.body:
## Summary
A community vote would make Phuzzle feel more alive and social, even for players who are not using co-op.

## Scope
- Let players vote on a small set of candidate puzzles or themes for the next featured puzzle.
- Surface results and winning entry in a simple, fun way.
- Keep the flow lightweight so it does not overwhelm the home screen.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Players can cast one vote during an active voting window.
- The UI clearly shows the candidate options and current state.
- The winning puzzle or theme is reflected in a later featured experience.
- The design works on mobile without becoming cramped.

issues.title: Improve share cards with more personality and player identity
issues.body:
## Summary
The app already supports result sharing well, but the share output could feel more memorable and more distinctly Phuzzle.

## Ideas
- Show selected theme or mode on the share card.
- Add cosmetic identity elements tied to player profile or unlocks.
- Offer a few share card visual styles.

## Scope
- Extend current share card generation without slowing down the happy path.
- Preserve the fast native-share-or-download behavior.
- Keep daily share and regular result share aligned where it makes sense.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Share cards gain at least one new visual customization axis.
- The output still feels clean and readable on mobile.
- Share creation stays reliable and fast.
- Existing share flows do not regress.

issues.title: Add post-game challenge prompts that create friend rivalry loops
issues.body:
## Summary
Phuzzle already has challenge sharing, but it could do more to turn a finished puzzle into the next social action.

## Ideas
- "Beat my time"
- "Same puzzle, fewer moves"
- "Try my exact settings"
- "Daily revenge" after a friend posts a better result

## Scope
- Add a few focused challenge prompts on completion.
- Reuse existing share and challenge infrastructure where possible.
- Make each prompt feel playful rather than spammy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Completion UI offers at least two concrete social challenge options.
- Shared challenge links preserve enough context to recreate the challenge.
- The prompts are optional and easy to ignore.
- Copy feels fun and on-brand.

issues.title: Add a guided onboarding track for first-time players
issues.body:
## Summary
The app has depth now. A new player should be able to discover core mechanics and fun features without bouncing.

## Scope
- Create a first-session onboarding flow that teaches the basics.
- Highlight one or two standout Phuzzle features such as daily, packs, replay, or challenge sharing.
- Avoid blocking experienced players or repeat visitors.

## Acceptance Criteria
- First-time players get a lightweight guided path into their first puzzle.
- The onboarding teaches drag, snap, tray usage, and one higher-level feature.
- Returning players can skip or never see redundant onboarding.
- The experience feels cozy and intentional, not corporate.

issues.title: Add a creator spotlight pack series with guest-curated puzzle sets
issues.body:
## Summary
A rotating creator spotlight could make the app feel like a living place instead of a static catalog.

## Scope
- Define a metadata model for guest-curated or featured packs.
- Add one UI treatment for spotlight content.
- Make the feature work with the existing packs experience.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The app can mark a pack as spotlighted and render it differently.
- Spotlight content appears naturally in the existing pack flow.
- The data model supports title, creator name, and short pack description.
- Spotlight content does not break existing pack completion behavior.

issues.title: Add accessibility option for larger UI scale and stronger readability
issues.body:
## Summary
Phuzzle already cares about accessibility, but players with low vision would benefit from a stronger readability mode beyond current theme and color-friendly settings.

## Scope
- Add an accessibility toggle for larger interface scale and stronger text readability.
- Tune critical screens such as home, setup modals, play HUD, completion, and stats.
- Keep the mobile layout stable even with larger text.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Players can enable a readability-focused UI mode from settings.
- Text, buttons, and critical HUD elements become easier to read without clipping.
- The mode works on mobile and desktop.
- At least one accessibility regression test is added.

issues.title: Add playful ambient soundscapes tied to packs and themes
issues.body:
## Summary
Snap sounds are a nice start, but ambient soundscapes could make Phuzzle feel much more premium and memorable.

## Ideas
- Rain or fireplace for Cozy
- Forest ambience for Nature
- Arcade synth for Retro
- Light space ambience for Space

## Scope
- Add an optional ambient audio layer with clear settings control.
- Respect reduced-motion and reduced-distraction expectations.
- Make sure it behaves well on mobile autoplay restrictions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Players can enable or disable ambient soundscapes.
- At least one pack or theme has a matching ambient track.
- Audio never auto-blasts unexpectedly and respects browser/device rules.
- The experience feels calm and additive, not distracting.

issues.title: Build a replay share flow so finished solves can be watched from a link
issues.body:
## Summary
Replay is already a cool feature. Turning it into a shareable artifact would make Phuzzle much more compelling to show off.

## Scope
- Add a way to publish or share a replay link after completion.
- Let another player watch the replay without needing the full original session context exposed.
- Keep performance reasonable for longer solves.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A completed puzzle can generate a replay link or replay share artifact.
- Another user can open the replay and watch the solve progression.
- The replay experience works on mobile.
- Privacy and payload size tradeoffs are documented and handled intentionally.
